claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the finite declared target
claim.meaning: Curated pointers to root-observed commands and raw evidence, not proof from filled fields, structural validation or correlated model agreement.

risk.boundary: Policy identity, budgets and skipped-value consumption through scalar and physical JSON handoffs
risk.rollback: One atomic local commit; no push or history rewrite.

production.change: One own-file JsonSkipPaths supplies detached sorted/deduplicated raw policy identity, duplicate-inclusive no-copy budget preflight, directional typed-path conflict and stock binary lower-bound behavior. Existing JSON descriptor/name/value/Object schema/parser/binding owners reuse it.
production.recursive_composition: Existing leaf/container codecs and physical owners are reused. Missing products mean unbound or unqualified physical state/coordinate handoffs, not a serializer per type Cartesian product.
production.budget_scope: Embedded raw paths retain the 256-byte cap; root Object path lengths remain operation-budget-bound. Supplied duplicate rosters are charged before proportional retained copies; inherited depth and borrowed aggregate budgets remain.
admission: JSON descriptor v0 nonzero SKIP-path rosters, immutable nominal equality/hash/canonical identity
shared policy through root Object schemas and existing complete Dynamic JSON binding rosters
skipped binary runtime values fully decoded, charged and validated before retained-row omission
materialized stored-row writing and bulk reading without applying text-ingestion SKIP normalization
stock directional typed-prefix conflict, binary exact/lower_bound predecessor law including final-prefix end behavior
raw SKIP keyword spelling in its separate presentation context
scalar wire raw REGEXP path identity without promoting its non-reconstructible SQL name
rejection: SKIP REGEXP clauses without a qualified RE2 backend
raw REGEXP SKIP path names at SQL-name-dependent reconstruction/schema/binding boundaries
empty, over-cap, duplicate-wire and exhausted-budget metadata; malformed skipped values
previous illegal/unbound constructors and unsupported physical profiles
production.unchanged: No new dependency, per-product value codec, physical storage layout, layout default, JSON text-ingestion API, Compact writer, aggregate family or native MV/projection writer.
